data.title: DeepSeek Coder is an open-source AI coding tool an
data.content:
## Summary
DeepSeek Coder is an open-source AI coding tool and series of models ranging from 1.3B to 33B parameters designed to rival proprietary systems like GPT-4. The video explores its performance benchmarks, its ability to generate functional games from simple prompts, and provides a walkthrough for local installation.

## Key Points
- DeepSeek Coder is an open-source alternative to ChatDev and Code Llama, available for both web and local use.
- The models are pre-trained on 2 trillion tokens across more than 80 programming languages.
- It supports a 16k window size for project-level code completion and infilling tasks.
- Benchmarks show the 33B model outperforms Code Llama 34B by significant margins in Python and multilingual tasks.
- Users can host the model locally using LM Studio to maintain privacy and utilize personal hardware.
- The tool is available for both research purposes and commercial use cases.

## AI Concepts
Large Language Models (LLMs), Fine-tuning, Instruction tuning, Pre-training, Tokenization, Foundational models, Context window, Fill-in-the-blank (FIM) tasks, HumanEval benchmarks, MBPP benchmark, DS-1000 benchmark
